title: Main ingredient up 40%
body: A poor harvest pushes the price of your main ingredient up 40% for six months.

title: A copy at half the price
body: A big brand launches a copy of your product at half your price, sold in the same shops.

title: Distributor wants more
body: Your main distributor demands 3 percentage points more margin, or it drops your product next month.

title: New labelling rule
body: A new rule means every pack needs a new label within 60 days; your current stock of 2 lakh printed packs cannot be sold after that.

title: A bad batch goes viral
body: A video of a spoiled pack from one batch goes viral, and sales fall 30% in a week.

title: Packaging supplier shuts
body: Your only packaging supplier shuts its factory for three months after a fire.

title: Season goes wrong
body: An unusually long monsoon cuts demand for your product by 25% this quarter.

title: Payments stuck
body: Your two largest retailers delay paying you for 90 days, and you have one month of cash left.
